name: IT Help Desk Password Reset
useCase: Enterprise IT help desk password recovery
headline: Forgot password? We already called you back.
prompt: Hi, I'm calling about the password reset you just requested.
description: Calls an employee back after they request a password reset, synchronizes a voice call with a browser flow, verifies presence across channels, and coaches them through a policy-compliant reset. The included implementation is a local demo that requires substantial security hardening before real use.
readiness: Demo reference implementation; not production-ready. Complete security, privacy, identity, accessibility, abuse-prevention, and operational reviews before deployment.

business.application: Give employees who click Forgot password an immediate outbound callback that verifies identity over a live voice call and browser wizard, then coaches them through a compliant password reset.
business.roi: Reduce routine Tier 1 handling and shorten employee recovery time after production controls and system integrations are in place.
business.metrics: Ticket deflection rate · Employee recovery time · Escalation rate

technical.systems: Azure Communication Services · Azure AI Voice Live · SignalR/WebSocket · Identity directory · Ticketing system
technical.build: Outbound call placement, voice-plus-browser code verification, real-time password-policy coaching, ticket creation and closure, and escalation on repeated identity failure.

expected.description: Poster image for the video player (WebP).
